tests.title: fail closed: no actor, a guardian and a school user get no answers; FLO exists for the four staff roles only
counts equal the selectors the screens use: notes behind, notes in review, units flagged, patients, per role
scope: direct support only hears about their own patients; every table row is a patient on the role's own roster
role limits: direct support has no denials and no intake forms; administrator is told note text is hidden by design
clinical text is never read or quoted: notes, diagnoses and medications are refused for every role, and no answer contains text from the clinician's full record
an unsupported question gets an honest limit and starters to try, never a guess; an empty question gets the help answer
every answer names its source, and a rule answer carries the rule's own source category
stage meanings: every stage the app has a plain meaning, and the answer is the meaning and nothing else
the Dashboard legend is read from the Dashboard's own icon map, so it cannot drift
links go only to screens the role may open
read-only: asking anything never changes the state it is given
khale: FLO opens on every platform page the role can open (2), focus lands in the input, Escape closes it, no console errors
cdiaz: FLO opens on every platform page the role can open (5), focus lands in the input, Escape closes it, no console errors
jperez: FLO opens on every platform page the role can open (7), focus lands in the input, Escape closes it, no console errors
dowens: FLO opens on every platform page the role can open (6), focus lands in the input, Escape closes it, no console errors
asking in the drawer: Enter sends, the answer has a summary, a table, links and a source line; a follow-up chip asks again; history survives closing and reopening; New chat clears
a link in an answer opens its screen and closes the drawer

direct support in the browser: own caseload only, denials answered as not part of the role
administrator in the browser: units and status answered, note text refused, nothing from a note on the page
